text.title: 迷雾行者之道
text.objectives: 在永恒岛上击败20只精英生物。
text.description: 你已经聆听了天神的教诲，但你在前往圣坛的途中又学到了什么呢？$b$b朝圣的智慧在于明心见性，直指本心。当你双耳听见树欲静而风不止之声，甚至就连翩翩起舞的小小蝴蝶都逃不过你的眼睛时，你就已经敞开了心门，汲取着试炼想要教会我们的最深邃的知识。也许你已经发现在岛屿四处游荡着许多庞大的猛兽？$b$b那就是你即将面对的试炼。潘达利亚让你学会了很多东西，现在就让这些知识接受实践的检验吧。
text.completion: Let this be your daily lesson, and let it hone your strength, wisdom, and fortitude.
text.completed: Return to Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Path of the Mistwalker
english.objectives: Defeat 20 Elite creatures on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: You have heard the words of the celestials, but what did you learn on your path to the shrines?$b$bThe wisdom of the pilgrimage is in its silence and simplicity. As you listen to the wind rustling in the trees, and note even the smallest butterfly, your mind is open to learning the deepest lessons the trials have to teach us. Perhaps you noticed the many great beasts that roam the island?$b$bTherein lies your trial. You have learned much from Pandaria, now let us put your knowledge to the test.
english.completion: Let this be your daily lesson, and let it hone your strength, wisdom, and fortitude.
english.completed: Return to Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 完善时光之眼
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 我已经磨好了石头，并且把沙漏调节到新的时间流序列了。你愿意返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场，再翻转一次沙漏吗？$b$b快点回去，我真是太好奇了。
text.completion: A tale of true heroism, and a powerful moment in history. But not quite what we are after, I am afraid.$B$BNot much time remains - I shall double my efforts.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Refining The Vision
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: I have finished grinding the stones, and have attuned the hourglass to a new series of timeways. Will you return to the Siege of Orgrimmar and turn the hourglass once more?$b$bReturn quickly, I am most curious.
english.completion: A tale of true heroism, and a powerful moment in history. But not quite what we are after, I am afraid.$B$BNot much time remains - I shall double my efforts.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 寻找命运
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 尽管你已经帮了时光旅行者这么多，我还是没能对你开诚布公。我无法把一切都告诉你，现在还不行，但你要知道的是，在我们当中存在叛徒。别对任何人透露你今天的使命，拿着时光之眼时要留心任何军团成员。$b$b抓紧时间，再次返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场使用沙漏。$b$b注意安全。
text.completion: Was that... me? How very interesting.$B$BNow we are beginning to see the shadows between worlds. Was this the future of our world, or simply one possibility? Regardless, our newfound ability to see more deeply into the timeways will allow us to push forward towards the answers we seek.$B$BAllow me some time to continue my research. And be vigilant, hero, for the timeways are as infinite as our enemies.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Seeking Fate
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: I have not been completely forthright with you, despite all that you have done to aid the Timewalkers. I cannot tell you everything, not yet, but know this - there is a traitor amongst us. Tell no one of your mission today, and take caution around any of my flight while you hold the Vision of Time.$b$bQuickly now, return to the Siege of Orgrimmar once more and use the hourglass.$b$bAnd be safe.
english.completion: Was that... me? How very interesting.$B$BNow we are beginning to see the shadows between worlds. Was this the future of our world, or simply one possibility? Regardless, our newfound ability to see more deeply into the timeways will allow us to push forward towards the answers we seek.$B$BAllow me some time to continue my research. And be vigilant, hero, for the timeways are as infinite as our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 销声敛迹
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 你保守了我们使命的秘密，我要为此向你道谢。时间流的知识一旦落在歹人手里，会引发灾难性的毁灭。我的军团现在还无力修复它。我们必须多加小心。$b$b沙漏的力量越来越强了。我相信和之前相比，现在可以用它看到更远的未来了。我希望你能把它的作用发挥到极致。$b$b返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场，把沙漏对准你能找到的最具毁灭性的时间流。
text.completion: Stormwind... destroyed?$B$BI realize that this vision may come as a shock to you. I know little more than you at this time. I will do my best to search for answers, you have my word.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Hidden Threads
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: You have kept our mission a secret, and for that I thank you. Knowledge of the timeways, when in the wrong hands, can cause catastrophic devastation. My flight has little power to repair it, now. We must be careful.$b$bThe hourglass grows in power. I believe it can now be used to see much further than before. I wish you to push it to its limits.$b$bReturn to the Siege of Orgrimmar, and focus the hourglass on the most devastating timeway you can find.
english.completion: Stormwind... destroyed?$B$BI realize that this vision may come as a shock to you. I know little more than you at this time. I will do my best to search for answers, you have my word.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 祈求命运
text.objectives: 在昆莱山的白虎寺使用时光之眼。
text.description: 时光之眼已经渐趋完美了，我们现在对要寻找的景象有了更大的控制力。正是因为你的努力，我们才得以完成这件神器，并使我的军团和我们的时光旅行者盟友恢复了力量。我们所有人都对你感激不尽。$b$b相当幸运的是，我在潘达利亚发现了某种时间的死结——那是时间流的交叉点。把时光之眼带到白虎寺。在那里的地窖中翻转沙漏。
text.completion: Ah, it seems that our little prince has a role to play yet. We should not speak further of this, lest we alter the future ourselves.$B$BThe woods have ears, hero. Keep silent, we will find our answers in time.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Courting Destiny
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: The Vision of Time is nearly perfected, we now have much more control over the visions we seek. Your efforts have been instrumental in completing the artifact and restoring the strength of not only my flight, but also our allies in the Timewalkers. All of us are in your debt.$b$bQuite fortunately, I have located a sort of crux in time - an intersection of timeways - right here in Pandaria. Take the Vision of Time to the Temple of the White Tiger. There, in the cellars, turn the hourglass.
english.completion: Ah, it seems that our little prince has a role to play yet. We should not speak further of this, lest we alter the future ourselves.$B$BThe woods have ears, hero. Keep silent, we will find our answers in time.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 最终行动
text.objectives: 在塔纳利斯的时光之穴中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 我不愿意再开口对你提出这个请求，可我不知道还有谁可以信任。我一直在用时光之眼收集信息，而在我的研究中，我相信我已经找到了时间的另一个交汇点。就在时光之穴。$b$b当我初次看到那番景象时，我不愿意相信这是真的，可我不能坐视不理，让这个信息白白溜走。时光之穴——你必须马上前往那里，使用时光之眼。$b$b动作要快！
text.completion: Soridormi, the prime consort of Nozdormu, dead? And I was there as well?$B$BWe cannot know what this means, or what will come to pass, or even if this vision takes place in our timeway. You must speak of this vision to no one, lest we alter the course of time and cause great danger to us all. All we can do now is complete the Vision of Time - it will show us what the future truly holds.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: One Final Turn
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
english.description: I do not wish to ask this of you again, but I do not know who I can trust any longer. I have been using the Vision of Time to gather information, and in my searches, I believe I have found another crux in time. It is in the Caverns of Time itself.$b$bI did not want to believe it when the vision first came to me, but I cannot sit idly by and let this information pass. The Caverns of Time - you must go there, now, and use the Vision of Time.$b$bMove quickly!
english.completion: Soridormi, the prime consort of Nozdormu, dead? And I was there as well?$B$BWe cannot know what this means, or what will come to pass, or even if this vision takes place in our timeway. You must speak of this vision to no one, lest we alter the course of time and cause great danger to us all. All we can do now is complete the Vision of Time - it will show us what the future truly holds.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.
